pictures.scene: Mihály Munkácsy, Christ before Pilate — the accused standing bound and silent while the council presses its charge against Him, vindicate me O God and plead my case against an ungodly nation
pictures.name: pd_munkacsy_christ_before_pilate

pictures.scene: Giotto, The Kiss of Judas — the betrayer folding his cloak round Him and leaning in to kiss Him while the torches and staves close round, deliver me from deceitful and unjust men, for You are the God of my refuge
pictures.name: pd_giotto_the_kiss_of_judas

pictures.scene: Ivan Kramskoi, Christ in the Wilderness — the solitary figure sitting on the cold stones at daybreak with His hands locked together, why have You rejected me, why must I walk in sorrow
pictures.name: pd_kramskoi_christ_in_the_wilderness

pictures.scene: William Holman Hunt, The Light of the World — Christ carrying His lantern through the night and knocking at the overgrown door, because of the enemy's oppression, send out Your light and Your truth
pictures.name: pd_holman_hunt_the_light_of_the_world

pictures.scene: Caspar David Friedrich, The Cross in the Mountains — the crucifix standing on the summit with the rays of the hidden sun coming up behind it, let them lead me, let them bring me to Your holy mountain
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_the_cross_in_the_mountains

pictures.scene: Pieter Saenredam, The Interior of St Bavo, Haarlem — the white pillars of the church going up out of sight into the vault, and to the place where You dwell, then I will go to the altar of God
pictures.name: pd_saenredam_interior_of_saint_bavo_haarlem

pictures.scene: Gerard van Honthorst, King David Playing the Harp — the king singing with his face lifted up over the strings, to God my greatest joy, I will praise You with the harp
pictures.name: pd_honthorst_king_david_playing_the_harp

pictures.scene: Francisco de Zurbarán, Saint Francis Kneeling in Meditation — the friar on his knees in the dark with his face turned up and his hands gathered in front of him, O God, my God
pictures.name: pd_zurbaran_saint_francis_in_meditation

pictures.scene: Vincent van Gogh, At Eternity's Gate — the old man sitting by the fire with his head down in his two fists, why are you downcast O my soul, why the unease within me
pictures.name: pd_van_gogh_at_eternitys_gate

pictures.scene: Master of Cefalù, Christ Pantocrator — the mosaic of Christ in the golden apse holding the open book and lifting His hand, put your hope in God for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God
pictures.name: pd_master_of_cefalu_christ_pantocrator

lines.text: Vindicate me, O God, and plead my case
deliver me from deceitful and unjust men.
For You are the God of my refuge.
Why must I walk in sorrow
Send out Your light and Your truth;
Let them bring me to Your holy mountain
and to the place where You dwell.
Then I will go to the altar of God,
I will praise You with the harp,
Why are you downcast, O my soul?
Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him,
